faq.q: Can I resize many images at once?
faq.a: Yes, up to 100 per batch, and they can be downloaded together as a ZIP.

faq.q: Does enlarging an image make it sharper?
faq.a: No. Making an image larger can't add detail, so it may look soft. Resizing down gives the best results.
